lead_raw_text:
The structure of LiCuP2O7 crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I4/mmm (No. 143), with a unit cell of Li4Cu4P8O28 (40 atoms) distributed over seven independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Cu in tetrahedral S-like coordination by four O neighbors, and Li in octahedral coordination by six O neighbors. P centers show four-coordinate O environments. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Cu tetrahedra and Li octahedra, and corner- and edge-sharing between Li octahedra. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 40 sites.
